statement: Of 84 initial samples, only 11 yielded prokaryotic ASVs after filtering and normalization
Sequencing retention was 37.2%, with 519,769 reads retained from 1,398,204 input reads
A total of 161 prokaryotic ASVs were recovered across the 11 retained samples
The 11 retained samples contributed a total of 46,656 prokaryotic reads after normalization
Pseudomonadota was the dominant phylum, accounting for 116 of 162 classified ASVs
Bacteroidota was the second most abundant phylum with 22 classified ASVs
Taxonomic classification was performed against the SILVA database
137 of 162 total ASVs were classified to the genus rank
One chloroplast ASV was detected across 3 samples with 26 reads
Campylobacterota comprised 13 of the classified ASVs, ranking third among phyla
